summary: Trinity escapes through a broken window onto a fire escape, where she sees Agent Smith below. Forced to move upward, she runs across rooftops pursued by Agent Brown and police. Trinity demonstrates superior agility by leaping a 40-foot gap with calm precision, landing and continuing to run, while Agent Brown replicates her movement exactly.
